segments.line: You keep the stunts going for two more days. Two more respawns.
And the power company notices. Three blackouts,
each one centered on a hospital, and each one longer than the last.
On the news, they call it a grid glitch.
Your mom calls it weird.
You don't call it anything, because your stomach just dropped.
The next morning, there's a black car outside your school.
A man in a grey suit is waiting by your locker.
He doesn't say hello. He just holds up a tablet.
A map of the city, with three red dots. Three hospitals. Three times.
'Half a second, ' he says. 'Then one second. Then two.
Every time you come back, the city goes dark, and it doubles. '
He leans closer. 'Hospitals run on that power.
Traffic lights. Elevators.
Today it's two seconds. Do it ten more times, and it's over half an hour. '
'So I just don't respawn, ' you say.
'Exactly, ' he says. 'Don't. Not once. Not until we understand it. '
He hands you a card with a phone number, and he's gone.
For the first time since the bar showed up, you're scared of it.
It's still floating there, full and green.
But now every chunk it loses is a step closer to the next blackout.
